supports: old proof accepted during several mixed states

content identity distinct from causal freshness
document version distinct from dependency/project generation

derived_judgments: Snapshot-valid and current-at-response are different query contracts.
Query-derived edits should validate the base semantic generation/dependencies atomically before application.
Concurrent authority-changing operations need a serializable or equivalently invariant-preserving admission rule when disjoint writes can violate a cross-resource invariant.
Per-file versions are sufficient only when they are proven to form one coherent admitted semantic snapshot.
Immutable generation manifests plus atomic selection and compare-and-swap can realize the needed guarantees without a database if all relevant authority transitions and dependencies are covered.
limits: No new Anneal or database execution was performed.
The database literature is used comparatively; it does not prescribe an Anneal implementation.
The smallest complete Anneal semantic dependency closure remains operation-dependent and partly unresolved.
Existing Anneal generation probes are bounded execution evidence, not a proof of all filesystem or concurrency behavior.
